peers.name: brainstorming
peers.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, modifying behavior, or planning anything new, in software or out of it (a talk, a business, a renovation).

peers.name: systematic-debugging
peers.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

peers.name: writing-plans
peers.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

peers.name: requesting-code-review
peers.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

en.tagline: Requires checking for skills before any agent response
en.summary: This skill tells the agent to look for and invoke relevant skills before it responds, asks a clarifying question, or takes any action. It also sets an order: process skills such as brainstorming and systematic-debugging run before implementation skills. It is meant to keep the agent from skipping a skill that applies to the task.
problem: An agent often answers or starts work without checking whether a skill exists for the task. It may ask clarifying questions, explore the codebase, or check files first, and it may rely on memory of a skill instead of the current version.

With this skill, the agent checks for applicable skills first. When one applies, it announces the skill, follows it, and creates a todo for each checklist item. If the skill turns out not to fit, the agent can drop it.
fit: Starting a new conversation in a project that has skills installed
Building a new feature, where brainstorming should come before implementation
Debugging a bug, where systematic-debugging should set the approach before domain skills run
unfit: A subagent dispatched to run one specific task, since the skill says to ignore it in that case
Sessions where the user has explicitly told the agent to skip skill workflows
steps: At the start of a conversation, the agent checks whether it was dispatched as a subagent; if so, the skill is ignored.
Before any response or action, including clarifying questions and file checks, the agent looks for relevant or requested skills.
Before entering plan mode, the agent invokes the brainstorming skill if it has not brainstormed yet.
When a skill applies, the agent announces "Using [skill] to [purpose]" and follows the skill exactly.
If the skill has a checklist, the agent creates a todo for each item.
When several skills apply, process skills run first and implementation skills follow; user instructions such as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md take precedence over skills.

zh.tagline: 在任何回复前先检查并调用相关技能
zh.summary: 该技能要求智能体在回复、提出澄清问题或采取任何行动之前，先查找并调用相关技能。它还规定了顺序：头脑风暴、系统化调试等流程类技能先于实现类技能运行。其目的是避免智能体漏掉适用于当前任务的技能。
problem: 智能体常常没有先检查是否存在适用的技能，就直接回答或开始工作。它可能先提出澄清问题、探索代码库或检查文件，也可能凭记忆使用某个技能，而不是读取当前版本。
使用该技能后，智能体会先检查适用的技能。找到适用技能时，它会说明正在使用哪个技能，严格按其执行，并为清单中的每一项建立待办。若技能不适合当前情况，智能体可以不用它。
fit: 在已安装技能的项目中开始新的对话
开发新功能，需要先头脑风暴再进入实现
调试缺陷，需要先由系统化调试确定方法，再运行领域技能
unfit: 作为子智能体被派去执行某个具体任务时，技能说明应忽略本技能
用户明确要求智能体跳过技能流程的会话
steps: 对话开始时，智能体先判断自己是否是被派遣的子智能体；若是，则忽略本技能。
在任何回复或行动之前，包括澄清问题和检查文件，智能体都会查找相关或被请求的技能。
进入计划模式前，若尚未做过头脑风暴，智能体会先调用头脑风暴技能。
当某个技能适用时，智能体会说明"Using [skill] to [purpose]"，并严格按该技能执行。
若技能包含清单，智能体会为每一项建立一个待办。
当多个技能适用时，流程类技能先运行，实现类技能随后执行；CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md 等用户指令优先于技能。
